newsitem.title: JAPAN: Big Japan aluminium mills' 1996 output up 2.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Big Japan aluminium mills' 1996 output up 2.4 pct.

text.p: Output of milled aluminium products at Japan's seven large fabricators rose 2.4 percent in 1996 from the year before to 1,526,505 tonnes, according to data submitted by the companies to the Japan Aluminum Federation and released on Monday.
The 1996 data was as follows (in tonnes):

The federation said beverage can output hit a record high for the third consecutive year, buoyed by strong demand in the beverage industry and a continued shift in the beer industry to cans from other containers.

It added that foil output was hurt by high inventories of condensors, although strong demand in the automobile sector and for heating and cooling systems in the construction sector lifted output for other flat-rolled products.
Total output of flat-rolled products hit a record high for the second year in a row.
Output of extruded products was boosted by strong demand from the transport and housing construction sectors, the federation said.

The seven companies are: Kobe Steel Ltd (includes KAAL joint venture with Alcoa), Sumitomo Light Metal Industries Ltd, Furukawa Electric Co, Mitsubishi Aluminum Co, Nippon Light Metal Co, Sky Aluminium Co and Showa Aluminum Corp.
